mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS decline reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (demand activity) above 900 units triggers expectations of robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when HOUST crosses above 900 (t-test p > 0.05) or surge reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and falling UNRATE (improving labor market) creates a dual expansionary signal, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies meet the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05) or one proxy reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 105), a sharp decline in FEDFUNDS intensifies accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS decline occurs during late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO reverts below 105 before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor participation) exceeding 5,000 units signals strong job market momentum, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS crosses above 5,000 (t-test p > 0.05) or surge reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDPC1 (demand) and monthly RSAFS (demand) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase in the next quarter
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies increase (t-test p > 0.05) or one proxy reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO below 100 indicates weakening supply conditions, prompting investors to anticipate lower inflation and positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or drop reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During contractionary monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a sharp decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals policy effectiveness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both conditions occur (t-test p > 0.05) or one proxy reverses before the horizon.
